public.title: Jump Game
public.description: Starting at index 0, values[i] is the maximum forward jump length from i. Return whether the last index can be reached. values contains 1 to 1000 integers from 0 to 1000. A single-element array is already reached.
hints: Keep the farthest reachable index while scanning reachable positions.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Every reachable position may extend the frontier. A gap before the final index proves failure. O(n) time and O(1) space.
